name: Fawaz Ahmed Hadith API
description: High-speed, CDN-backed static JSON Hadith API providing complete collections of the canonical Kutub al-Sittah and other primary Hadith works. Includes full Arabic texts, multi-language translations (English, Urdu, Bengali, French, etc.), chapters/sections breakdown, and scholarly authenticity gradings (Sahih, Hasan, Da'if).

rateLimit.policy: Unlimited via jsDelivr CDN edge network.

endpoints.name: API & Books Overview
endpoints.description: Returns metadata regarding supported books, grades, languages, and dataset statistics.

endpoints.name: List All Editions
endpoints.description: Returns dictionary of all available Hadith edition keys categorized by language and author (e.g. 'eng-bukhari', 'ara-muslim', 'urd-abudawud').

endpoints.name: Get Full Hadith Book / Edition
endpoints.description: Retrieves the complete edition with all contained hadiths, metadata, and chapter indices.

endpoints.name: Get Specific Hadith by Number
endpoints.description: Retrieves a single hadith record by its sequential number in the edition.

endpoints.name: Get Section / Chapter Hadiths
endpoints.description: Retrieves all hadiths falling within a specific chapter or thematic book section.
